notes.notes: [p][i]The playtest version is now considered a legacy archive of Silvan Visitants and will[b] no longer be updated[/b].[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Since all of my projects up to this point have had [i]very minimal[/i] and closed testing among a few friends, I see no reason to try things here when I'll have to recreate the [i]entire steam page[/i], achievements, DLC, stats, Leaderboards and so on for the base game App ID.[/h2][h3]I was just testing things out in Steamworks, this rl isn't the right fit for such a small group of testers.[/h3][p][/p][p]To whichever 4 or so people that have access to this, [i]consider yourself the owners of an outdated and unobtainable build of the game.[/i][/p][p]Thas about it.ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891809/62308b78e69b7293a8e607cd6263e910b551f091.png"][/img][/p]
